title: 공항에서의 귀빈 예우에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:9:2:00010:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 9-2 (Press Conferences in VIP Lounges)
(1) The head of each ministry or agency, including the head of an equivalent agency, may apply to the President of Incheon International Airport Corporation or the President of Korea Airports Corporation to hold a press conference in a VIP lounge upon entry into or departure from the country.
(2) Where the President of Incheon International Airport Corporation or the President of Korea Airports Corporation approves a press conference in a VIP lounge under paragraph (1), he or she shall notify the applicant thereof.
